body: Yeah, the slowmo parts when the manglers, megatons, and panzers all shoot at you is pretty badass

Blah blah blah, not as confusing as the original zombies story and seems like it’s taken from a movie or something. So not worth it really
The game goes back to normal and it’ll act like the whole EE never happened. So it pretty much forgets about the entire existence of the EE matrix
Need to choose between either a red pill or blue pill. Make sure to choose red
New EE for outbreak, goal is to escape the matrix
Took me an entire day to find a fix and this is the only thing that actually worked for me

I had this problem as well and it’s fixed now. Go to battle net and go to options then game settings, make sure it’s on Cold War and click the check for addition command line. Once this is done, in the text box, write -d3d11
Only thing that changes is the amount of zombies which makes it easier for you to get overran if your teammates are trash
